items.title: Correct global/repository/subtree scope
No broader rule where a narrower file is appropriate
Correct client discovery and precedence behavior
No hidden override/fallback conflict
Concise repository or personal-context orientation
Scannable headings and actionable bullets
Critical rules appear before optional references
No avoidable duplication or low-value context cost
Large files use valid client-specific modularization
Commands exist and match the repository
Windows/path/shell guidance is accurate
Local references resolve or are explicitly optional/ghost
Reference loading semantics match the client
Architecture and important-directory guidance is current
Engineering conventions are project-specific
Definition of done names proportional verification
Destructive/external/high-authority actions retain human gates
Secrets and sensitive data guidance is least privilege
Repository ownership and dirty-tree rules are accurate
Nested files add local rules without restating parents
Client-only tool names do not leak across clients
Instructions agree with current manifests, CI, docs, and paths
Review guidance flags behavior and safe alternatives
Changes, unresolved items, and limitations are explicit
